issue.title: Diagnose the swallowed-exception raiser behind the two test_vcs_tag_* xprompt-selector flake nodes
issue.description: Proposed by sase-h8's land phase (bead sase-h8.10.4, epic sase-h8) while closing out the parallel-suite flake class. tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and ::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves were triaged by sase-h8.3 as family F1 (off-pump settle gap) and handed to sase-h8.4 to fix. sase-h8.4 falsified that assignment: on_prompt_input_bar_snippet_requested is fully synchronous (no pilot, no message pump, no worker/thread/to_thread anywhere in the project-local lookup), so there is no off-pump boundary to inject a delay at. The real mechanism is a swallowed exception -- the lookup block in src/sase/ace/tui/actions/_prompt_bar_requests.py ended in 'except Exception: pass', so any raise (leading candidate: a stale sase_core_rs binding surfacing through resolve_project_config_read_path -> resolve_project_layout, the same root cause the sase-h8.3 triage table records for the F4 node test_malformed_header_block_leaves_authored_metadata_visible) is indistinguishable from 'this project has no xprompts'. This matches the durable health store exactly: all 3 recorded occurrences failed as a pair, and one run (20260807T010908Z-e3bfbbcbfe21) has these two as its ONLY two failures. sase-h8.4 landed instrumentation rather than a bogus wait: the swallow now does log.exception(), and both tests assert via caplog that nothing was swallowed, so a recurrence will fail loudly naming the traceback instead of silently mismatching. It verified the guard by injecting 'raise OSError' into the lookup (both tests then fail together, reproducing the store's exact pairing signature), but the actual production raiser has not recurred since the instrumentation landed, so the underlying defect is still unfixed. Residual work: watch for the caplog assertion to fire under real load (dev host or CI), capture the traceback it now surfaces, and fix the raiser at its mechanism.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during BY_DATE bucket-anchor verification on 2026-08-09: the first 'just check' escalated to the full suite and failed exactly tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and ::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves after 27,908 passes / 10 skips. The change under verification touched only agent BY_DATE grouping/docs/tests, not xprompt selector or project registry state. Immediate isolated rerun of those two nodes passed (2 passed in 4.07s), and a subsequent 'just check' rerun passed, matching the existing fail-under-full-parallel-load/pass-in-isolation signature.

Independent recurrence on master at 957219ef2 (2026-08-09), and it REFUTES the swallowed-exception hypothesis for this occurrence. Ran a plain 'just test' on an idle athena (granted 28 workers, 220s wall): 2 failed / 27976 passed / 10 skipped, and the only two failures were exactly tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and ::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves — the same pairing signature the health store records. Decisive new detail: sase-h8.4's instrumentation did NOT fire. The traceback shows _assert_no_swallowed_lookup_failure(caplog) passing and the failure landing two lines later on 'assert "proj/thing" in modal._extra_prompts' with 'AssertionError: assert "proj/thing" in {}'. So on this run nothing was swallowed and logged at ERROR, yet the project-local lookup still produced an empty _extra_prompts. That points away from 'a raise inside the lookup is being hidden' and toward the lookup legitimately finding no project-local xprompts under load — e.g. the _gh_project fixture's on-disk ProjectSpec/workspace state or one of the three list_project_records monkeypatches not being observed by the code path under xdist, rather than an exception being eaten. Immediate isolated rerun of the whole file passed 17/17 in 2.33s. Note the file path is tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py, not the tests/ace/tui/widgets/... path this bead's description gives. Found while measuring 'just test' cost baselines for a test-suite-performance plan; the change under investigation was measurement-only and touched no repo files.

Independent recurrence after close on HEAD 3420d12113c6 during unrelated test-module split verification on 2026-08-10. just check escalated to the 14-worker full suite and failed exactly test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves after 28,459 passes and 10 skips; both passed immediately in an isolated rerun (2 passed in 1.01s). A separate workspace was concurrently exercising the same prompt-bar test module, reinforcing the full-parallel/shared-state signature. The split only moved agent-list-entry tests and does not touch xprompt discovery or ACE prompt-bar code.
